key: TITANIA: Coming back here was stupid.
en: TITANIA: Coming back here was stupid.
ja: ティタニア: ここに戻ってきたのは　バカだったな。

key: I was talking to Amy just now, but I said the wrong thing like usual and she swam off.
en: I was talking to Amy just now, but I said the wrong thing like usual and she swam off.
ja: さっき　エイミーと　話してたんだが　いつもみたいに　余計なことを　言っちまって　泳いで　行っちまった。

key: \PN, you wanna go after her?
en: \PN, you wanna go after her?
ja: \PN　追いかけてくれるか?

key: I doubt she'll listen to anything I say right now.
en: I doubt she'll listen to anything I say right now.
ja: 今は　あたしの言うことなんて　何も　聞かないだろうしな。

key: She won't have gone far.
en: She won't have gone far.
ja: そう遠くには　行ってないはずだ。

key: This whole Gym is her underwater playground.
en: This whole Gym is her underwater playground.
ja: このジム全体が　あいつの　水中の遊び場だからな。

key: On some days, the only thing that keeps her alive is getting lost down there.
en: On some days, the only thing that keeps her alive is getting lost down there.
ja: 日によっちゃ　あそこで　迷子になることだけが　あいつを　生かしてるんだ。

key: Sometimes she'll stay under for hours.
en: Sometimes she'll stay under for hours.
ja: 何時間も　潜ったままの　こともある。

key: The time she spent alone under there was some of the best time I had too...
en: The time she spent alone under there was some of the best time I had too...
ja: あいつが　一人で　水の下で　過ごしてた時間は　あたしにとっても　最高の時間だった……

key: I can hardly breathe when she's around, even above water.
en: I can hardly breathe when she's around, even above water.
ja: あいつが　そばにいると　水面の上でさえ　息が　ろくにできない。

key: And if you say that sounds romantic, I'll hold you under.
en: And if you say that sounds romantic, I'll hold you under.
ja: それを　ロマンチックだなんて　言ったら　水の下に　沈めてやるからな。

key: That was the only time I was free.
en: That was the only time I was free.
ja: あれだけが　あたしが　自由だった時間だ。

key: The rest of it I spent just trying to hold her together.
en: The rest of it I spent just trying to hold her together.
ja: 残りの時間は　全部　あいつを　支え続けるのに　費やしてた。

key: And we all know how well holding water works.
en: And we all know how well holding water works.
ja: で　水を　手で　すくうのが　どれだけ　うまくいくかは　みんな　知ってるよな。

key: Ugh, I'm just complaining again.
en: Ugh, I'm just complaining again.
ja: ああ　また　愚痴っちまったな。

key: Go find her.
en: Go find her.
ja: 探してきてくれ。

key: I'll be here.
en: I'll be here.
ja: あたしは　ここにいる。

key: TITANIA: Amy should be hiding somewhere in her underwater playground.
en: TITANIA: Amy should be hiding somewhere in her underwater playground.
ja: ティタニア: エイミーは　あいつの　水中の遊び場のどこかに　隠れてるはずだ。

key: TITANIA: You found her?
en: TITANIA: You found her?
ja: ティタニア: 見つけたか?

key: She hasn't come back here yet. What did she say?
en: She hasn't come back here yet. What did she say?
ja: まだ　ここには　戻ってきてないな。何て　言ってた?

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: ああ。

key: She's talking like that again.
en: She's talking like that again.
ja: また　あんな調子で　話してるのか。

key: Ugh.
en: Ugh.
ja: はあ。

key: Just go drag her up here.
en: Just go drag her up here.
ja: 引きずってでも　ここに　連れてきてくれ。

key: TITANIA: She's still being stubborn?
en: TITANIA: She's still being stubborn?
ja: ティタニア: まだ　意地を　張ってるのか?

key: Then why are you here?
en: Then why are you here?
ja: なら　なんで　ここに　いるんだ?

key: Go get her.
en: Go get her.
ja: 連れてこい。

key: AMARIA: So... \PN, right?
en: AMARIA: So... \PN, right?
ja: アマリア: それで……\PNよね?

key: What brings you here?
en: What brings you here?
ja: 何しに　来たの?

key: And where's Tania?
en: And where's Tania?
ja: それで　ターニャは　どこ?

key: She sent you ahead, alone?
en: She sent you ahead, alone?
ja: あんた一人だけ　先に　寄こしたの?

key: She should just come here herself.
en: She should just come here herself.
ja: 自分で　来ればいいのに。

key: In fact, I'm just gonna take a swim until she gets here.
en: In fact, I'm just gonna take a swim until she gets here.
ja: てか　あいつが来るまで　泳いでるから。

key: Bye!
en: Bye!
ja: テンシ: バイバイ!

key: TITANIA: Can we talk now?
en: TITANIA: Can we talk now?
ja: ティタニア: 話せるか?

key: AMARIA: Well, before that, \PN has a Gym Battle after all, and--
en: AMARIA: Well, before that, \PN has a Gym Battle after all, and--
ja: アマリア: まあ　その前に\PNは　結局　ジムバトルが　あるわけだし――

key: TITANIA: \PN can wait.
en: TITANIA: \PN can wait.
ja: ティタニア: \PNは　待たせておけ。

key: You're in danger.
en: You're in danger.
ja: あんたは　危険な状態なんだ。

key: AMARIA: W-what?
en: AMARIA: W-what?
ja: アマリア: な　何?

key: TITANIA: A lot happened during the time you don't remember.
en: TITANIA: A lot happened during the time you don't remember.
ja: ティタニア: あんたが　覚えてない間に　いろいろ　あったんだ。

key: You tried to kill yourself. Team Meteor found your Bracelets.
en: You tried to kill yourself. Team Meteor found your Bracelets.
ja: あんたは　自殺を　図った。メテオ団が　あんたのブレスレットを　見つけた。

key: Now \PN has to keep them for your life.
en: Now \PN has to keep them for your life.
ja: だから　あんたの命のために　今は\PNが　それを　預かってる。

key: Also--
en: Also--
ja: それと――

key: AMARIA: Oh! So you're going to stay and protect me, right?
en: AMARIA: Oh! So you're going to stay and protect me, right?
ja: アマリア: あら! じゃあ　そばに　いて　守ってくれるってこと?

key: TITANIA: Y-yeah...
en: TITANIA: Y-yeah...
ja: ティタニア: あ　ああ……

key: AMARIA: Hey, what's that look for?
en: AMARIA: Hey, what's that look for?
ja: アマリア: ねえ　その顔　何?

key: Don't worry about the Bracelets, okay?
en: Don't worry about the Bracelets, okay?
ja: ブレスレットのこと　気にしないで　いいから。

key: I treasured them ever since you gave them to me, but they're just bracelets.
en: I treasured them ever since you gave them to me, but they're just bracelets.
ja: あんたに　もらってから　ずっと　大事にしてたけど　ただの　ブレスレットだもの。

key: As long as I have you here with me, they don't matter at all.
en: As long as I have you here with me, they don't matter at all.
ja: あんたが　ここに　いてくれるなら　そんなの　どうでもいい。

key: You understand, right?
en: You understand, right?
ja: わかるでしょ?

key: TITANIA: Yeah...
en: TITANIA: Yeah...
ja: ティタニア: ああ……

key: AMARIA: Thank you for always looking after me.
en: AMARIA: Thank you for always looking after me.
ja: アマリア: いつも　面倒　見てくれて　ありがと。

key: I love you, Tania.
en: I love you, Tania.
ja: 愛してるよ　ターニャ。

key: TITANIA: I...
en: TITANIA: I...
ja: ティタニア: あたしは……

key: AMARIA: It's okay, you don't have to say it.
en: AMARIA: It's okay, you don't have to say it.
ja: アマリア: いいよ　言わなくても。

key: I know it'd be embarrassing for you to say something like that in front of a challenger!
en: I know it'd be embarrassing for you to say something like that in front of a challenger!
ja: 挑戦者の前で　そんなこと言うの　恥ずかしいよね　わかってるって!

key: TITANIA: Right...
en: TITANIA: Right...
ja: ティタニア: ああ……

key: I'll stay with you as always.
en: I'll stay with you as always.
ja: いつもどおり　そばに　いてやる。

key: AMARIA: Thank you~
en: AMARIA: Thank you~
ja: アマリア: ありがと～

key: So! Shall we have our battle now?
en: So! Shall we have our battle now?
ja: さて! バトル　しましょうか?

key: TITANIA: Do whatever you want. I'm going to step outside.
en: TITANIA: Do whatever you want. I'm going to step outside.
ja: ティタニア: 好きにしな。あたしは　外に　出てる。

key: AMARIA: I'm ready when you are, \PN!
en: AMARIA: I'm ready when you are, \PN!
ja: アマリア: いつでも　いいよ\PN!

key: AMARIA: Shall we go again?
en: AMARIA: Shall we go again?
ja: アマリア: もう一回　やる?

key: AMARIA: I don't know why she's so worried.
en: AMARIA: I don't know why she's so worried.
ja: アマリア: なんで　あんなに　心配してるのか　わかんない。

key: Even if someone did come for me, it's just that lucky mistake I needed.
en: Even if someone did come for me, it's just that lucky mistake I needed.
ja: もし　誰かが　あたしを　狙ってきても　それは　ちょうど　欲しかった　ラッキーな失敗ってだけ。

key: That's all I am anyway.
en: That's all I am anyway.
ja: どのみち　あたしなんて　その程度のもの。

key: But Tania will be with me again, so that's all that matters.
en: But Tania will be with me again, so that's all that matters.
ja: でも　ターニャが　また　一緒に　いてくれるなら　それだけで　十分。

key: Do you think less of me?
en: Do you think less of me?
ja: あたしのこと　軽く見た?

key: AMARIA: That's okay. I understand.
en: AMARIA: That's okay. I understand.
ja: アマリア: いいよ。わかってる。

key: You're probably right to.
en: You're probably right to.
ja: たぶん　それで　正しいんだと思う。

key: AMARIA: Really?
en: AMARIA: Really?
ja: アマリア: 本当に?

key: It's hard for me to believe that after everything I've said and done.
en: It's hard for me to believe that after everything I've said and done.
ja: あたしが　あれだけのこと　言ったり　したりした後じゃ　信じにくいけど。

key: Until she decides to leave, I'll hang onto her as long as I can.
en: Until she decides to leave, I'll hang onto her as long as I can.
ja: あいつが　離れる決心を　するまでは　できる限り　しがみついてる。

key: Then maybe I'll finally go under.
en: Then maybe I'll finally go under.
ja: そしたら　やっと　沈んでいけるかも。

key: But that's okay.
en: But that's okay.
ja: でも　それで　いいの。

key: Oh, \PN, do you prefer Single Battles or Double Battles?
en: Oh, \PN, do you prefer Single Battles or Double Battles?
ja: あ\PN　シングルバトルと　ダブルバトル　どっちが　好き?

key: Normally, the Gym Leader decides the format on their own, but I know a lot of challengers have their own preference.
en: Normally, the Gym Leader decides the format on their own, but I know a lot of challengers have their own preference.
ja: 普通は　ジムリーダーが　形式を　自分で　決めるんだけど　好みが　ある挑戦者も　多いって　知ってるから。

key: Oh, and no changing your mind once you've decided!
en: Oh, and no changing your mind once you've decided!
ja: あ　それと　一度　決めたら　変更なしだからね!

key: So what'll it be?
en: So what'll it be?
ja: それで　どっちに　する?

key: AMARIA: Aha, okay!
en: AMARIA: Aha, okay!
ja: アマリア: あはっ　オッケー!

key: You're definitely in the majority there, so I'm used to battling that way too.
en: You're definitely in the majority there, so I'm used to battling that way too.
ja: それなら　断然　多数派だから　その形式でも　慣れてるよ。

key: AMARIA: Wow, really?
en: AMARIA: Wow, really?
ja: アマリア: わあ　ホントに?

key: You're quite the rare one, you know?
en: You're quite the rare one, you know?
ja: なかなか　珍しい子　だね?

key: But in that case I'm set to splash. Are you?
en: But in that case I'm set to splash. Are you?
ja: でも　それなら　あたしは　準備万端。あんたは?

key: AMARIA: Great!
en: AMARIA: Great!
ja: アマリア: よし!

key: Now, regardless of what happens, just try to have fun, okay?
en: Now, regardless of what happens, just try to have fun, okay?
ja: さて　何が　起ころうと　とにかく　楽しんでね　いい?

key: That's what really matters. So if you can live in the moment, then you're already winning!
en: That's what really matters. So if you can live in the moment, then you're already winning!
ja: それが　一番　大事なことだから。今この瞬間を　生きられれば　もう　勝ったも　同然だよ!

key: At least, that's something I've had to tell myself a lot.
en: At least, that's something I've had to tell myself a lot.
ja: 少なくとも　あたしは　自分に　何度も　言い聞かせてきたことだけどね。

key: So focus on what's right in front of you, and own it!
en: So focus on what's right in front of you, and own it!
ja: だから　目の前のことに　集中して　自分のものに　しちゃいな!

key: Good game! That was amazing!
en: Good game! That was amazing!
ja: いい勝負だったね! すごかったよ!

key: AMARIA: And there you go! Congratulations!
en: AMARIA: And there you go! Congratulations!
ja: アマリア: それで　決まり! おめでとう!

key: You've earned the Torrent Badge. Take it!
en: You've earned the Torrent Badge. Take it!
ja: げきりゅうバッジを　手に入れたよ。受け取って!

key: \PN received the Torrent Badge!
en: \PN received the Torrent Badge!
ja: \PNは　げきりゅうバッジを　受け取った!

key: AMARIA: Now that you have that, you can use the move Rock Climb outside of battle at any time!
en: AMARIA: Now that you have that, you can use the move Rock Climb outside of battle at any time!
ja: アマリア: それが　あれば　バトル外でも　いつでも　ロッククライムが　使えるようになるよ!

key: And, you should take this!
en: And, you should take this!
ja: それと　これも　受け取って!

key: AMARIA: ...
en: AMARIA: ...
ja: アマリア: ……

key: Thanks for going along with it, \PN.
en: Thanks for going along with it, \PN.
ja: 付き合ってくれて　ありがと\PN。

key: It's easier to battle with a fake smile.
en: It's easier to battle with a fake smile.
ja: 作り笑いを　浮かべてるほうが　バトルは　楽なの。

key: I'm sure you have a lot of other things to do, so I'll go now.
en: I'm sure you have a lot of other things to do, so I'll go now.
ja: あなたにも　他に　やることが　いろいろ　あるだろうから　もう　行くね。

key: AMARIA: Oh, that's okay, take your time!
en: AMARIA: Oh, that's okay, take your time!
ja: アマリア: あ　大丈夫　ゆっくりで　いいよ!

key: AMARIA: You're back?
en: AMARIA: You're back?
ja: アマリア: 戻ってきたの?

key: Welcome home.
en: Welcome home.
ja: おかえり。

key: You won't go anywhere this time either.
en: You won't go anywhere this time either.
ja: 今度も　どこにも　行かないんだね。

key: Live my misery.
en: Live my misery.
ja: あたしの惨めさを　生きて。

key: AMARIA: I'm sorry...
en: AMARIA: I'm sorry...
ja: アマリア: ごめんね……

key: AMARIA: "The voice of the sea is seductive; never-ceasing,
en: AMARIA: "The voice of the sea is seductive; never-ceasing,
ja: アマリア: 「海の声は　誘惑的で　絶え間なく

key: Whispering, clamoring, murmuring, inviting the soul to wander for a spell in abysses of solitude."
en: Whispering, clamoring, murmuring, inviting the soul to wander for a spell in abysses of solitude."
ja: ささやき　叫び　つぶやき　魂を　孤独の奈落で　しばし　さまよわせるよう　いざなう」

key: But there's no sea here.
en: But there's no sea here.
ja: でも　ここに　海は　ない。

key: There's no soul.
en: There's no soul.
ja: 魂も　ない。

key: And even solitude is too good for me.
en: And even solitude is too good for me.
ja: 孤独ですら　あたしには　もったいない。

key: That's why you're here, right?
en: That's why you're here, right?
ja: だから　あなたは　ここに　来たんでしょ?

key: You're standing there thinking, "She's unforgivable,
en: You're standing there thinking, "She's unforgivable,
ja: そこに立って　こう思ってる「彼女は　許せない

key: Just give me my Badge already,
en: Just give me my Badge already,
ja: さっさと　バッジを　くれよ

key: Stop whining for attention,
en: Stop whining for attention,
ja: かまってほしくて　愚痴るのは　やめろ

key: There's nothing really wrong with you."
en: There's nothing really wrong with you."
ja: 本当は　どこも　悪くないくせに」って。

key: Right?
en: Right?
ja: でしょ?

key: But you don't get it!
en: But you don't get it!
ja: でも　わかってないんだよ!

key: Even if there were nobody here at all, there's still someone there saying those things.
en: Even if there were nobody here at all, there's still someone there saying those things.
ja: たとえ　ここに　誰も　いなくても　それでも　そう言う誰かが　いるの。

key: It's the part of me that only shuts up when she's around.
en: It's the part of me that only shuts up when she's around.
ja: それは　彼女が　そばに　いるときだけ　黙ってくれる　あたしの一部。

key: It's the part of me that I can't kill.
en: It's the part of me that I can't kill.
ja: それは　あたしが　殺せない　あたしの一部。

key: You know I've tried.
en: You know I've tried.
ja: 試したこと　あるのは　知ってるでしょ。

key: And the worst part is...
en: And the worst part is...
ja: 一番　最悪なのは……

key: I don't know who I am without it.
en: I don't know who I am without it.
ja: それがなければ　自分が　何者かすら　わからないこと。

key: There's a part of me still livid with you, too.

key: Maybe you've done nothing wrong.

ja: あんたは　何も　間違ってないのかも　しれない。

key: But it's because of you that she's gone.
en: But it's because of you that she's gone.
ja: でも　彼女が　いなくなったのは　あんたの　せいなんだから。

key: So in the end, one of us is going to have to hold the other under.
en: So in the end, one of us is going to have to hold the other under.
ja: だから　結局　どっちかが　もう片方を　水の下に　沈めるしか　ないんだよ。

ja: 挑戦者と　バトルするとき　形式的に　こう聞くの。

en: Do you prefer Double or Single Battles?
ja: ダブルバトルと　シングルバトル　どっちが　好き?

key: I can do either one.

ja: どっちでも　いいよ。

key: AMARIA: Singles, huh?
en: AMARIA: Singles, huh?
ja: アマリア: シングルか。

key: Too bad.
en: Too bad.
ja: 残念だったね

key: AMARIA: Doubles, really?
en: AMARIA: Doubles, really?
ja: アマリア: ダブル　本当に?

key: Are you sure you're not lying?
en: Are you sure you're not lying?
ja: ウソじゃ　ないよね?

key: Let's find out.
en: Let's find out.
ja: 確かめてみましょ。

key: After all, I never promised to listen.
en: After all, I never promised to listen.
ja: だって　聞くとは　約束してないもの。

key: Misery loves company like I love her. That's why we're alone from now on.
en: Misery loves company like I love her. That's why we're alone from now on.
ja: わたしが　あの子を　愛したように　不幸は　道連れを　愛するの。だから　これからは　ひとりきり

key: Misery loves company like I love her. That's why we're alone.
en: Misery loves company like I love her. That's why we're alone.
ja: わたしが　あの子を　愛したように　不幸は　道連れを　愛するの。だから　わたしたちは　ひとりきり

en: AMARIA: This is the Torrent Badge.
ja: アマリア: これが　げきりゅうバッジ。

key: AMARIA: It enables the move Rock Climb.
en: AMARIA: It enables the move Rock Climb.
ja: アマリア: ロッククライムが　使えるようになる。

key: This is the TM for Scald.
en: This is the TM for Scald.
ja: これは　ねっとうの　わざマシン。

key: AMARIA: Now go.
en: AMARIA: Now go.
ja: アマリア: さあ　行って。

key: I set you free.
en: I set you free.
ja: あんたを　自由にしてあげる。

key: Both you and her.
en: Both you and her.
ja: あんたも　彼女も。

key: And if anything happens to me,
en: And if anything happens to me,
ja: それで　もし　あたしに　何か　あったら

key: Know that I will finally be at peace.
en: Know that I will finally be at peace.
ja: やっと　安らげたんだって　思ってて。

key: TITANIA: Will you stay and talk now?
en: TITANIA: Will you stay and talk now?
ja: ティタニア: 今度こそ　残って　話してくれるか?

key: You tried to kill yourself. Team Meteor found your Bracelets. Now \PN has to keep them for your life.
en: You tried to kill yourself. Team Meteor found your Bracelets. Now \PN has to keep them for your life.
ja: あんたは　自殺を　図った。メテオ団が　あんたのブレスレットを　見つけた。だから　あんたの命のために　今は\PNが　それを　預かってる。

key: Also, we...
en: Also, we...

key: AMARIA: Thank you, Tania~
en: AMARIA: Thank you, Tania~
